name: Titanium.UI.iOS.WebViewConfiguration
summary: A collection of properties used to initialize a web view.
description:
Use the [Titanium.UI.iOS.createWebViewConfiguration](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#createWebViewConfiguration) method to create and use as a parameter of [Titanium.UI.WebView.configuration](api:Titanium.UI.WebView#configuration).
Using this you can determine how soon a webpage is rendered, how media playback is handled, the granularity of items that the
user can select, and many other options. This property can only be set when creating the webview and will be ignored when set afterwards.

See the example section "Usage of WebViewConfiguration with WebView in iOS".
Information on additional available preferences can be derived from the original WebKit sources:
[WKPreferences.mm](https://github.com/WebKit/webkit/blob/main/Source/WebKit/UIProcess/API/Cocoa/WKPreferences.mm)

properties.name: allowsAirPlayMediaPlayback
properties.summary: A Boolean value indicating whether AirPlay is allowed.

properties.name: allowsInlineMediaPlayback
properties.summary: A Boolean value indicating whether HTML5 videos play inline or use the native full-screen controller.
properties.description:
You must set this property to play inline video. Set this property to true to play videos inline.
Set this property to false to use the native full-screen controller. When adding a video element
to a HTML document on the iPhone, you must also include the playsinline attribute.
The default value for iPhone is false and the default value for iPad is true.
properties.default: For iPhone false and for iPad true.

properties.name: allowsPictureInPictureMediaPlayback
properties.summary: A Boolean value indicating whether HTML5 videos can play picture-in-picture.

properties.name: mediaTypesRequiringUserActionForPlayback
properties.summary: Determines which media types require a user gesture to begin playing.

properties.name: preferences
properties.summary: The preference settings to be used by the web view.

inlined.name: WebViewPreferencesObject
inlined.summary: The parameter passed to the [Titanium.UI.iOS.WebViewConfiguration.preferences](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.WebViewConfiguration#preferences) method.

properties.name: javaScriptCanOpenWindowsAutomatically
properties.summary: A Boolean value indicating whether JavaScript can open windows without user interaction.

properties.name: javaScriptEnabled
properties.summary: A Boolean value indicating whether JavaScript is enabled.
properties.description:
Setting this property to false disables JavaScripts that are loaded or executed by the web page.
This setting does not affect user scripts.

properties.name: minimumFontSize
properties.summary: The minimum font size in points.

properties.name: processPool
properties.summary: The process pool from which to obtain the  Web Content process of view.
properties.description:
When a web view is initialized, either a new web content process is created for it from the
specified pool or an existing process in that pool is used.

properties.name: selectionGranularity
properties.summary: The level of granularity with which the user can interactively select content in the web view.

properties.name: suppressesIncrementalRendering
properties.summary:
A Boolean value indicating whether the web view suppresses content rendering until it is fully
loaded into memory.
